Parent issue: #489

Stage: local-session-inspection-mvp

## Task

Implement the sanitized local-session inspection MVP from parent issue #489. Add a versioned sanitized trace format and export CLI supporting canonical JSON/JSONL plus Markdown/text; preserve user/assistant messages and minimal provenance while excluding credentials, environment snapshots, raw tool payloads, and archives. Reuse the existing GitHub attachment downloader, require a source issue-comment URL, verify the attachment is referenced by that comment, enforce schema/size/record limits, and compute a digest. Add a manual agent-local-session-inspection workflow with destination memory/rubrics/both and branch-ref inputs, using session_policy none. Add a dedicated prompt that treats uploaded content as untrusted evidence and persists only distilled durable repository memory or explicit trusted-user preferences—never the raw transcript. Post a summary containing the digest and separate memory/rubrics commit outcomes without quoting sensitive content. Add parser, security, workflow-contract, and prompt-guardrail tests; update relevant .agent documentation; run the complete .agent CI suite. Do not implement provider-session restoration or live resumption, and do not change release notes.
